Name: Better Slingshots
Author: CatCattyCat
Description:
[size=6]Better Slingshots

[/size][size=4][b]This mod:[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][size=4]Adds automatic firing for the master and galaxy slingshots (you can also make the basic one auto fire). Better slingshots fire faster.[/size]
[*][size=4]Lets every slingshot automatically reload the same ammo it was firing when it runs out.[/size]
[*][size=4]Lets you aim exactly where your mouse is (no inverse aiming).[/size]
[*][size=4]Makes the galaxy slingshot obtainable for 50000 tokens in the casino. It deals the most damage and fires the fastest.[/size]
[*][size=4]Fixes the non-exact aiming bug in the base game.[/size]
[*][size=4]Fixes the ammo being consumed even when the slingshot doesn't fire bug in the base game.[/size]
[/list][size=4]
[b]To fire an automatic slingshot:[/b]
[list=1]
[*]Press and hold down your use tool button (By default, left click) to bring up the slingshot.
[*]Press and hold down your action button (By default, right click) to fire it.
[/list][/size][size=4]
[b][size=5]Fully multiplayer compatible! Other people's animations might look a bit weird when they're firing the slingshot, that's normal.[/size][/b]

[b]Config options (options in bold are default):[/b]
[list]
[*][u]DisableReverseAiming[/u]: [b]true[/b]/false: Makes projectiles fire at your mouse instead of the inverse position.
[*][u]AutoReload[/u]: [b]true[/b]/false: Whether to auto reload or not.
[*][u]AutomaticSlingshots[/u]: [b]["Galaxy", "Master"]:[/b] A comma separated list of names of slingshots to be made automatic. To add the normal slingshot, add "Basic" to the list.
[*][u]ShowActualMousePositionWhenAiming[/u]: [b]true[/b]/false: Whether to also show the red target at the mouse's position while aiming.
[/list][b]Cheaty Config options (all disabled by default):[/b]
[list]
[*][u]CanMoveWhileFiring[/u]: true/[b]false[/b]: Lets you move while aiming. Note that your character sprite won't animate so it will look weird.
[*][u]InfiniteAmmo[/u]: true/[b]false[/b]: Shooting doesn't take up ammo. You still need at least one ammo in the slot though.
[*][u]RapidFire[/u]: true/[b]false[/b]: All automatic slingshots fire twice as fast.
[*][u]GalaxySlingshotPrice[/u]: [b]50000[/b]: The number of tokens it costs to purchase the galaxy slingshot from the casino.
[/list]
Requires [url=https://smapi.io]SMAPI[/url] by Pathoschild.

[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/users/44734342?tab=user+files][size=5]Check out my other mods by clicking here![/size][/url][/size]
